controls.positive: the class's traces satisfy the recursion

notes: Truncating the infinite system at |n| <= K+1 is safe because Tr K^n = O(q^|n|) (measured on the trace row), so the dropped terms enter beyond q^K.

checks.name: eq:uqsl2rec  q^2n (Tr K^n + q χ_1 Tr K^n+1 + q^2 Tr K^n+2) = Tr K^n + q χ_1 Tr K^n-1 + q^2 Tr K^n-2 on the SQED_2 traces, 0 <= n <= 4, through q^10
eq:uqsl2con (n < 0 form)  (1 - q^-2n) Tr K^n = -q χ_1 Tr K^n+1 - q^2 Tr K^n+2 + q^1-2n χ_1 Tr K^n-1 + q^2-2n Tr K^n-2, -4 <= n <= -1
iterating eq:uqsl2con from Tr 1 = [x^0]G and Tr K^n = O(q) reproduces [x^n]G for 1 <= |n| <= 4 through q^10 (the unique solution)
the iteration is well-posed: every right-hand-side term carries a positive power of q (orders < k determine order k)
checks.note: by inspection of eq:uqsl2con: the coefficients q^{2n+1}, q^{2n+2}, q, q^2 (n>0) and q, q^2, q^{1-2n}, q^{2-2n} (n<0) are all positive powers
